statusDetail: Coverage-complete audit of the mandatory age gate plus representative underlying homepage, listing/search/category DOM, video detail, and failure route. Explicit-content screenshots after entry were intentionally not retained; structural probes covered those templates.

page.framework: server-rendered legacy multi-page application with extensive jQuery-style scripting
page.notes: French regional adult-media site. The mandatory age gate overlays content already present in the DOM.

artifacts.caption: Mobile age gate showing clipped fixed-width content
Compact trace timing and blocking summary
Compact request, byte, third-party, and blocking summary
Lighthouse performance, accessibility, best-practices, SEO, and agentic audit
Raw HTML versus rendered discoverability analysis
Post-interaction readable heap summary after ten toggles
Preference and modern CSS feature probe
Route, action, language, and metadata recon
Heap-use, DOM-size, focus-target and touch-target probe

checkOutcomes.evidence: The age gate is already dark, remains legible under prefers-color-scheme: dark, and does not flash a light surface.
With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce active, document.getAnimations() returned zero running animations.
Under forced-colors: active and prefers-contrast: more, text, links, borders, and both age-choice buttons remain clearly visible.
No view-transition rules were found on the age-gate state or representative page templates; state changes use legacy immediate swaps.
No scroll-linked animation or scrollytelling surface was observed, so there is no scroll-linked behavior to implement declaratively.
checkOutcomes.reason: No scroll-linked animation or scrollytelling surface was observed, so there is no scroll-linked behavior to implement declaratively.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The tested browse, search, category, age-gate, and detail journeys expose no custom swipe, pull, or gesture-driven interaction.
checkOutcomes.reason: The tested browse, search, category, age-gate, and detail journeys expose no custom swipe, pull, or gesture-driven interaction.

checkOutcomes.method: CSS feature probe and long-page DOM review
checkOutcomes.evidence: The long listing surface has no scroll-state queries or progress/scroll affordance; chrome remains static.

checkOutcomes.method: Overlay inventory and CSS feature probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: No tooltip or edge-attached popover requiring anchor positioning was available in the tested unauthenticated journey.
checkOutcomes.reason: No tooltip or edge-attached popover requiring anchor positioning was available in the tested unauthenticated journey.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The mandatory gate uses a central heading, explanatory copy, and two clearly ordered choices; global navigation labels are explicit.
The full-screen age gate is legally and contextually necessary for an adult service, clearly explains its purpose, and offers enter and exit actions.
The mandatory modal is an ad-hoc DIV with role=dialog rather than a native <dialog>; no native dialog element is present.
The gate is visually spare: one message, two primary choices, and supporting legal links without competing decoration.
The mobile screenshot visibly clips the 780px fixed dialog and the second age-choice button; content extends beyond the viewport even though root overflow is suppressed.
No @container rules were found across reused listing/card templates; responsiveness is viewport-only.
Focusing the first reachable control produced outline:none and box-shadow:none; numerous text controls are only 15–22px high.
The gate states that this is an adults-only site and presents explicit enter and exit choices.
At 360px the required entry flow is clipped horizontally and the under-18 exit action is largely off-screen, obstructing the first mandatory step.
The access state is explicit and reversible through enter/exit actions; an invalid path returns users to the guarded homepage rather than a blank shell.
Lighthouse measured LCP 4.4s (poor) and TTI 7.8s; trace corroborated a 2.30s LCP on a faster run.
Mobile layout CLS was 0.102, just outside the good <=0.1 range; desktop measured 0.062 and Lighthouse 0.095.
The trace recorded zero long tasks and 0ms TBT; Lighthouse measured 42ms TBT, comfortably good despite 2.4s aggregate main-thread work.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR summary confirmed against live script attributes
checkOutcomes.evidence: The load transfers 6.4MB across 172 requests with seven parser-blocking stylesheets and multiple synchronous head scripts; Lighthouse estimates 450ms render-blocking savings.
Lighthouse estimates 286KiB unused JavaScript, 74KiB unused CSS, and 54KiB avoidable legacy JavaScript.
axe found 30 untitled iframes; the detail probe found 12/12 iframes untitled and one image without alt.

checkOutcomes.method: Forced-colors visual test plus Lighthouse/axe review
checkOutcomes.evidence: Forced-colors preserved all gate controls and text; Lighthouse raised no scored color-contrast failure (axe marked contrast for manual review only).

checkOutcomes.method: axe landmark audit and programmatic focus probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: axe found 116 regions outside landmarks, and focus can move to a background Cookie Notice link with no visible outline while the modal is active.
Large text and legal copy are clipped at the right edge on mobile, requiring unavailable horizontal access and harming comprehension.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse viewport audit, 360px screenshot, media inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse reports a viewport zoom restriction in the audited render; the 360px gate fails reflow, and the tested detail video exposes no caption/subtitle track.
Lighthouse scored errors-in-console at 0, confirming browser errors during load.
Doctype and UTF-8 are valid, but three images lack dimensions and Lighthouse flags unsized images; 33/37 images lack responsive srcset.
Lighthouse found two deprecated-API warnings, inspector issues, legacy JS, and four BFCache failure reasons.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM metadata probe across entry and detail
checkOutcomes.evidence: Both entry and video detail use the generic title “Pornhub”; no meta description is present.
Lighthouse found non-crawlable links and an invalid robots.txt; 30 homepage anchors have empty or javascript: href values.

checkOutcomes.method: Metadata, HTTP, robots, and sitemap probes
checkOutcomes.evidence: Pages ship noindex,nofollow, the detail canonical points to the homepage, /robots.txt redirects to HTML, and /sitemap.xml is a 404.
No Open Graph tags or JSON-LD were present, including on a concrete video detail page.
HTTPS and HSTS are present, but CSP and nosniff are missing; cookie rp is not Secure and all seven cookies use SameSite=None.
101/172 requests and 2.39MB are third-party; active Google Tag Manager/DoubleClick tracking and TrafficJunky advertising are present on the age gate.
No permission prompt appeared on load; the delivered UI includes passkey continuation and passkey.js support for sign-in.
HSTS and SAMEORIGIN are configured, but CSP/frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, and nosniff are absent.

checkOutcomes.method: Raw-HTML discoverability comparison with JS-disabled crawler screenshot
checkOutcomes.evidence: Only 29% of rendered content tokens survive in raw HTML and the crawler screenshot is entirely blank, so core guarded content is not usable without JavaScript.
The mandatory dialog is fixed at 780px and cut off in the 360px runtime, including a primary exit control.
This streaming media service is intrinsically online; no offline/installable intent is declared, so PWA installability is not required.
checkOutcomes.reason: This streaming media service is intrinsically online; no offline/installable intent is declared, so PWA installability is not required.

checkOutcomes.evidence: A deliberately invalid path silently redirects to the guarded homepage instead of presenting a clear 404 explanation or recovery choices.
The French host declares html lang=fr and the gate offers an accessible language selector with many localized choices; default LTR is appropriate.
The tested guarded entry and browsing metadata exposed no dates, currencies, or locale-sensitive numeric inputs requiring formatting judgement.
checkOutcomes.reason: The tested guarded entry and browsing metadata exposed no dates, currencies, or locale-sensitive numeric inputs requiring formatting judgement.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No scheduling, event, deadline, or user-entered time-zone surface appears in the tested journey.
checkOutcomes.reason: No scheduling, event, deadline, or user-entered time-zone surface appears in the tested journey.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The age gate states its purpose plainly and offers symmetric enter/exit choices; cookie controls include an essential-only option without confirmshaming.
The representative unauthenticated browse flow has only a search field and no required data-entry form with validation/error states to exercise.
checkOutcomes.reason: The representative unauthenticated browse flow has only a search field and no required data-entry form with validation/error states to exercise.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The search input has an accessible name, sensible text type, and no obstruction to native input; account/payment forms were not part of the public browse flow.
No checkout, subscription purchase, consent change, or authenticated account-management flow was entered; the representative task was public age-gated browsing.
checkOutcomes.reason: No checkout, subscription purchase, consent change, or authenticated account-management flow was entered; the representative task was public age-gated browsing.

checkOutcomes.method: Images primitive and Lighthouse delivery insight
checkOutcomes.evidence: 22/37 images use legacy formats, 33 lack srcset, and Lighthouse estimates 510KiB image savings.
The guarded first view still makes 172 requests, including 38 fetch/XHR requests, before the user enters; this is disproportionate background work for a blocking gate.
Third parties account for 101 requests and 2.39MB, including 1.17MB from TrafficJunky advertising before age confirmation.
No configuration or site signal declares an agent-facing capability; this emerging check is not required for the guarded adult-media browse experience.
checkOutcomes.reason: No configuration or site signal declares an agent-facing capability; this emerging check is not required for the guarded adult-media browse experience.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No user task in the audited flow calls for on-device inference, summarisation, or a built-in language model.
checkOutcomes.reason: No user task in the audited flow calls for on-device inference, summarisation, or a built-in language model.

checkOutcomes.method: Baseline/post heap snapshots around ten language-control toggles
checkOutcomes.evidence: After ten representative gate-control toggles, heap self size fell from 38.53MB to 37.73MB; node count changed by only 0.22%, with no unbounded retained growth signal.
The loaded gate and underlying listing used about 28MB live JS heap, 38.5MB snapshot self-size, and 1,426 DOM elements, proportionate for this media listing.
No Detached* constructor appears in either top-constructor summary; total heap shrank and closure count was effectively flat (52,365 to 52,374).

principleOutcomes.reason: No configuration or site signal declares an agent-facing capability; this emerging check is not required for the guarded adult-media browse experience. No user task in the audited flow calls for on-device inference, summarisation, or a built-in language model.

paths.description: Homepage and mandatory age gate; global template, consent, navigation, metadata, security, performance and privacy.
Mandatory first-step age gate at a narrow mobile viewport; core entry/exit journey and reflow.
Video listing archetype represented by /video; regional routing returned the guarded homepage while underlying listing DOM was structurally probed.
Category/index archetype; regional routing returned the guarded homepage, recorded as representative of listing navigation.
Search-results journey for a benign query; regional routing returned the guarded homepage, while the search form itself was inspected.
Concrete video-detail archetype; DOM, media, headings, canonical, forms, frames and script delivery inspected without retaining explicit post-entry screenshots.

findings.summary: State changes do not use View Transitions
findings.evidence: Runtime/CSS probe found no view-transition usage on the mandatory gate or representative pages.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-document View Transitions for gate and major state changes, while honoring reduced motion.

findings.summary: Long listings lack scroll-state-aware navigation
findings.evidence: No scroll-state query, progress indicator, or scroll-aware chrome was detected.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight scroll-state-aware header or progress/return affordance on long listings.

findings.summary: Mandatory modal uses a custom DIV
findings.evidence: DOM evidence shows role=dialog on a DIV and no native dialog element.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement the gate with <dialog>, a programmatic accessible name, focus trapping, and native close semantics where appropriate.

findings.summary: Age gate is clipped on mobile
findings.evidence: At 360x800 the fixed 780px dialog clips legal copy and the second mandatory choice off-screen.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace the fixed width with max-inline-size: min(100% - 2rem, 780px), use logical padding, wrap actions, and test 320–400px reflow.

findings.summary: Reusable cards do not use component-level responsiveness
findings.evidence: CSS probe found no @container use across reused listing/card surfaces.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable card/list components containment and adapt their layout with container queries.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is invisible and targets are cramped
findings.evidence: Focused controls report outline:none/box-shadow:none; many link-like controls are only 15–22px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Add :focus-visible rings and enlarge interactive target boxes to at least 24px, preferably 44px for primary touch actions.

findings.summary: LCP and interactivity miss the performance bar
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured 4.4s LCP and 7.8s TTI.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP resource, reduce initial document/script work, and defer non-gate content until after consent/entry.

findings.summary: Critical path is oversized and render-blocked
findings.evidence: HAR records 6.4MB/172 requests with parser-blocking CSS/scripts; Lighthouse estimates 450ms render-blocking savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline only gate-critical CSS, defer or module-load scripts, and delay listings/ads/analytics until needed.

findings.summary: Large unused and legacy bundles ship on the gate
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 286KiB unused JS, 74KiB unused CSS, and 54KiB legacy JS savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split the age gate from the content application and ship a modern, minimal gate bundle.

findings.summary: Mobile CLS is just outside the good range
findings.evidence: The mobile layout observer measured CLS 0.102.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve dimensions for late content and fonts and remove the late gate/layout adjustment causing the shift.

findings.summary: Advertising/media frames lack accessible names
findings.evidence: axe found 30 untitled iframes; the detail page had 12/12 untitled.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every meaningful iframe a concise title and hide non-semantic ad frames from assistive technology when appropriate.

findings.summary: Modal focus and landmark structure are broken
findings.evidence: Focus reaches a background Cookie Notice link with no visible outline; axe found 116 regions outside landmarks.
findings.suggestedFix: Use native dialog focus management, inert the background, add visible focus styles, and place content in named landmarks.

findings.summary: Reflow, zoom, and media alternatives are incomplete
findings.evidence: Lighthouse flags viewport zoom restrictions, the gate clips at 360px, and the tested video exposes no caption track.
findings.suggestedFix: Preserve unrestricted zoom, fix 320px reflow, and expose captions/subtitles or an equivalent transcript for media.

findings.summary: Console errors occur during normal load
findings.evidence: Lighthouse errors-in-console audit scored 0.
findings.suggestedFix: Resolve runtime/network errors and add release monitoring that fails on new uncaught errors.

findings.summary: Image markup is incompletely sized and responsive
findings.evidence: Three images lack dimensions and 33/37 lack srcset.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare intrinsic width/height and responsive srcset/sizes for thumbnails and logos.

findings.summary: Deprecated APIs and BFCache blockers remain
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found two deprecations, inspector issues, legacy JS, and four BFCache blockers.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove deprecated APIs and unload-related BFCache blockers; resolve DevTools Issues and modernize delivery.

findings.summary: Page titles are generic and descriptions missing
findings.evidence: Entry and detail pages both use “Pornhub”; no meta description is present.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate unique localized titles and concise descriptions for each public archetype.

findings.summary: Links and robots endpoint are not crawler-safe
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found non-crawlable anchors and 4,073 robots.txt errors; many anchors are empty/javascript links.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real href destinations and serve a valid text/plain robots.txt without redirecting to HTML.

findings.summary: Indexing signals contradict public detail pages
findings.evidence: Detail pages use homepage canonical, noindex/nofollow, robots redirects, and sitemap is 404.
findings.suggestedFix: Choose an explicit regional indexing policy; if pages are public, self-canonicalize, remove accidental noindex, and publish consistent robots/sitemaps.

findings.summary: Detail pages lack structured and social metadata
findings.evidence: No JSON-LD or Open Graph tags were found on the tested video detail.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate VideoObject JSON-LD and Open Graph metadata matching visible content and regional policy.

findings.summary: Transport is HTTPS but key protections and cookie flags are weak
findings.evidence: CSP and nosniff are missing; one cookie lacks Secure and every cookie uses SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP and nosniff; mark all cookies Secure and use Lax/Strict unless cross-site use is essential.

findings.summary: Tracking starts before the user enters
findings.evidence: The gate loads 101 third-party requests/2.39MB, including GTM, DoubleClick, and TrafficJunky.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer non-essential analytics and advertising until explicit consent and age entry; minimize events and third-party origins.

findings.summary: Defensive browser policies are incomplete
findings.evidence: Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, CSP/frame-ancestors, and nosniff are absent.
findings.suggestedFix: Add least-privilege Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy plus CSP frame-ancestors and Trusted Types where feasible.

findings.summary: No-JavaScript crawler view is blank
findings.evidence: Discoverability captured a blank crawler screenshot and only 29% raw/rendered token coverage.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render the age notice and essential navigation/actions, using JavaScript only to enhance behavior.

findings.summary: Mandatory runtime UI is cut off at narrow widths
findings.evidence: The 780px fixed modal exceeds a 360px viewport and clips actions.
findings.suggestedFix: Use intrinsic sizing and wrapped actions so the modal survives narrow and zoomed conditions.

findings.summary: Invalid routes fail silently
findings.evidence: A deliberately invalid path redirected to the homepage without a 404 explanation.
findings.suggestedFix: Return a correct 404 status and a localized recovery page with search, home, and back actions.

findings.summary: Images miss modern responsive delivery
findings.evidence: 22/37 images are legacy formats, 33 lack srcset, and Lighthouse estimates 510KiB savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Negotiate AVIF/WebP, provide responsive sources, and retain explicit dimensions.

findings.summary: The blocking age gate still loads the full application
findings.evidence: Before entry the page performs 172 requests, including 38 fetch/XHR operations.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a minimal gate and defer listing data, recommendations, ad auctions, and secondary scripts until entry/consent.

findings.summary: Third-party budget is disproportionate on first view
findings.evidence: Third parties contribute 101 requests and 2.39MB; TrafficJunky alone transfers 1.17MB.
findings.suggestedFix: Set and enforce a third-party byte/request budget and load advertising only after the guarded flow completes.
